import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    prices = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    q = int(data[1 + n])
    queries = data[2 + n:2 + n + 3 * q]
    done = [False] * n
    floor = 0
    # Reverse scan: the first point assignment met is the last one in forward order,
    # and floor is then the largest global threshold after it.
    for i in range(3 * q - 3, -1, -3):
        if queries[i] == b'2':
            v = int(queries[i + 1])
            if v > floor:
                floor = v
        else:
            x = int(queries[i + 1]) - 1
            if not done[x]:
                done[x] = True
                v = int(queries[i + 2])
                prices[x] = v if v > floor else floor
    for i in range(n):
        if not done[i] and prices[i] < floor:
            prices[i] = floor
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, prices)) + '\n')


main()
